# Setup and Import
`r what_this_does("Loaded required bioinformatics packages (limma, clusterProfiler, msigdbr).", "Imported the pre-cleaned clinical spine and Olink proteomics matrix.", "Fetched the Human Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Processes database for downstream pathway enrichment analysis.")`
```{r setup_import, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(limma)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)

# Knitr Config
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

# Output paths
current_file <- "03b_proteomics_differential"
output_dir_data <- here::here("output", current_file)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir_data)) dir.create(output_dir_data, recursive = TRUE)

assets_dir <- here::here("docs", "assets", current_file)
if (!dir.exists(assets_dir)) dir.create(assets_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Source Engines
source(here::here("code", "01_general_engines.R"))
source(here::here("code", "02_proteomics_engines.R"))

# Load Pre-Cleaned Data from Script 01a and 01b (Twin Spine Architecture)
# CRITICAL: We strictly load the master_spine (text/factors) because limma
# requires categorical factors for group contrasts, not the numeric_spine!
master_spine <- readRDS(here::here("output", "01b_clinical_feature_engineering", "curated_clinical_spine.rds"))
omics_mat <- readRDS(here::here("output", "01a_data_import_and_qc", "clean_olink_matrix.rds"))

pathway_dbs <- list(
  "Hallmark" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "GO_BP" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "Immunologic_Signature" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C7") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol),
  "Reactome" = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME") %>% select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
)
```

# Analysis Configurator
`r what_this_does("Defined global mathematical thresholds for Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA).", "Configured targeted Differential Expression Analysis (DEA) contrasts, specifying reference groups, target groups, and required covariates (e.g., Age, Sex, Sample_Age).", "Established Trajectory mapping rules to compare protein and pathway shifts across multiple distinct contrasts.")`
```{r analysis_config}
# 1. Global Mathematical Thresholds (apply to GSEA)
omics_config <- list(
  gsea_p_cutoff    = 0.20, 
  gsea_min_size    = 3,
  network_p_cutoff = 0.10  
)


# 3. Differential Expression Contrasts (Target vs Reference)

# Manually define your covariates here based on the findings from Script 03a!
candidate_vars <- list(
  set1 = c()
)

contrast_configs <- list(
  ssc_vs_control = list(
    title = "SSc vs Control",
    group_col = "cohort_group",
    target_groups = c(GRP_ACTIVE, GRP_NON_ACTIVE),
    ref_groups = c(GRP_CONTROL),
    is_continuous = FALSE,
    covariates = c("Age", "Sex"),
    dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
    dea_fc_cutoff = 0.5
  ),
  
    ssc_vs_control_sample_age = list(
    title = "SSc vs Control",
    group_col = "cohort_group",
    target_groups = c(GRP_ACTIVE, GRP_NON_ACTIVE),
    ref_groups = c(GRP_CONTROL),
    is_continuous = FALSE,
    covariates = c("Age", "Sex", "Sample_Age"),
    dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
    dea_fc_cutoff = 0.5
  ),
  
  active_vs_nonactive = list(
    title = "Active vs Nonactive",
    group_col = "cohort_group",
    target_groups = c(GRP_ACTIVE),
    ref_groups = c(GRP_NON_ACTIVE),
    is_continuous = FALSE,
    covariates = c("Age", "Sex"),
    dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
    dea_fc_cutoff = 0.2
  ),
  
  eustar_aactive_vs_nonactive = list(
    title = "EUSTAR Act vs Nonact",
    group_col = "ACTIVE_AI",
    target_groups = c("1"), 
    ref_groups = c("0"),     
    is_continuous = FALSE,
    covariates = c("Age", "Sex"), 
    dea_p_cutoff = 0.05,
    dea_fc_cutoff = 0.5
  )
)

## 4. Cross-Contrast Trajectory Plots
cross_contrast_configs <- list(
  cc_svc_vs_svc_sa_cor = list(
    title = "SSc vs Control contrasted with SSc vs Control (Sample_Age corrected)",
    x_source = "ssc_vs_control",                # Must map to the variable name loaded in Setup
    y_source = "ssc_vs_control_sample_age",    # Generated dynamically: f_id + algo_name + contrast_name
    x_label = "SSc vs Control",
    y_label = "SSc vs Control Sample_Age corrected",
    color_x = "#e67e22",                      # Orange
    color_y = "#2980b9",                      # Blue
    highlight_color = "#27ae60",              # Green
    top_n_specific = 8,
    top_n_shared = 8,
    p_cutoff = 0.05,   
    fc_cutoff = 0.58    # Set to 0 if you want overlapping based solely on FDR
  )
)

# 5. Heatmap Configuration
heatmap_config <- list(
  top_n = 30,
  split_by_group = FALSE, 
  row_font_size = 8
)

```


# Differential Expression Analysis & GSEA {.tabset}
`r what_this_does("Executed linear modeling (limma) for each defined contrast to identify differentially expressed proteins while adjusting for covariates.", "Generated Volcano plots and static Heatmaps to visualize significant fold changes and expression clusters.", "Performed Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) on full fold-change ranked lists and rendered Dot and Ridge plots for biological interpretation.")`

```{r execution_engine_DEA_GSEA, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
global_dea_payloads <- list()
master_gsea_results <- list()

for (c_name in names(contrast_configs)) {
  
  # Run Master Pipeline (go_db passed as NULL since engine uses pathway_dbs from global env)
  res <- wrap_dea_pipeline(
    omics_mat           = omics_mat, 
    clin_df             = master_spine, 
    dea_conf            = contrast_configs[[c_name]], 
    dea_id              = c_name, 
    base_output_dir     = output_dir_data, 
    go_db               = NULL, 
    omics_config        = omics_config, 
    heatmap_config      = heatmap_config, 
    project_colors_func = get_project_colors
  )
  
  # 1. Generate the Tab Header
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s\n\n", contrast_configs[[c_name]]$title))
  cat(sprintf("*Diagnostic: Samples used: %d Target, %d Reference*\n\n", 
              res$diagnostics$n_target, res$diagnostics$n_ref))
  
  if(res$status == "failed") {
    cat(sprintf("> <span style='color:red;'>**SKIPPED:** %s</span>\n\n", res$error_msg))
    next
  }
  
  # Store Master Results
  global_dea_payloads[[c_name]] <- res$data$dea
  
  # Extract primary GO_BP database for downstream trajectory plotting to satisfy the flat-dataframe requirement
  if (!is.null(res$data$gsea[["GO_BP"]])) {
    master_gsea_results[[c_name]] <- res$data$gsea[["GO_BP"]]
  } else if (length(res$data$gsea) > 0) {
    master_gsea_results[[c_name]] <- res$data$gsea[[1]]
  }

  # 2. Render Volcano
  print(res$plots$volcano)
  cat("\n\n")
  
  # 3. Render Table
  if(nrow(res$tables$significant_proteins) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Significant Proteins (%d total)\n\n", nrow(res$tables$significant_proteins)))
    
    html_table <- kbl(res$tables$significant_proteins, format = "html", digits = 4, align = "c", 
              caption = sprintf("Significant Results: %s", contrast_configs[[c_name]]$title)) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
          scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "500px")
    
    cat(as.character(html_table))
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  # 4. Render Heatmap
  draw(res$plots$heatmap)
  cat("\n\n")

  # 5. Render Nested GSEA Plots (Loops through databases dynamically)
  if (!is.null(res$plots$gsea) && length(res$plots$gsea) > 0) {
    
    # Create the parent header and declare it as a tabset
    # (Assuming your contrast title is ##, this should be ###)
    cat("\n\n### Pathway Enrichment {.tabset .tabset-pills .toc-ignore}\n\n") 
    
    for (db_name in names(res$plots$gsea)) {
      db_plots <- res$plots$gsea[[db_name]]
      
      if (!is.null(db_plots)) {
        # Create the sub-header for this specific database (the Tab title)
        cat(sprintf("\n\n#### %s\n\n", db_name))
        
        # Print the plots as normal
        if(!is.null(db_plots$dotplot)) { print(db_plots$dotplot); cat("\n\n") }
        if(!is.null(db_plots$ridgeplot)) { print(db_plots$ridgeplot); cat("\n\n") }
        if(!is.null(db_plots$emap)) { print(db_plots$emap); cat("\n\n") }
      }
    }
    # Optional: Add a break after the tabset to ensure subsequent sections aren't absorbed
    cat("\n\n") 
  }
}
```

# Trajectory Mapping {.tabset}
`r what_this_does("Mapped the fold changes of proteins across two distinct clinical contrasts to identify shared and diverging biological trajectories (Quadrant Plots).", "Generated Venn diagrams to visualize the intersection of significant features between contrasts.", "Calculated and plotted cross-contrast pathway trajectories to reveal higher-order biological mechanisms driving cohort differences.")`
```{r execution_engine_trajectory, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, results='asis'}
# Ensure the export directory exists
cc_dir <- file.path(output_dir_data, "Cross_Contrasts")
if (!dir.exists(cc_dir)) dir.create(cc_dir, recursive = TRUE)

for (cc_id in names(cross_contrast_configs)) {
  conf <- cross_contrast_configs[[cc_id]]
  
  # Inject Parent Tab Header for this Comparison
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## %s {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n\n", conf$title))
  
  # 1. Fetch DEA X
  dea_x <- if (exists(conf$x_source)) get(conf$x_source) else global_dea_payloads[[conf$x_source]]

  # 2. Fetch DEA Y
  dea_y <- if (exists(conf$y_source)) get(conf$y_source) else global_dea_payloads[[conf$y_source]]
  
  if (is.null(dea_x) || is.null(dea_y)) {
    cat(sprintf("*Error: Could not locate DEA source payload(s) for %s.*\n\n", cc_id))
    next
  }
  
  # 3. Execute Engine
  cc_res <- run_cross_contrast_engine(
    dea_x = dea_x, 
    dea_y = dea_y, 
    conf = conf, 
    x_label = conf$x_label, 
    y_label = conf$y_label, 
    color_x = conf$color_x, 
    color_y = conf$color_y, 
    highlight_color = conf$highlight_color, 
    title = conf$title
  )
  
  if (!is.null(cc_res)) {
    
    # --- SUB-TAB: SCATTER PLOT ---
    cat("\n\n### Scatter Plot\n\n")
    
    ggsave(file.path(cc_dir, paste0(cc_id, "_cross_contrast.png")), cc_res$plot, width = 9, height = 7, bg = "white")
    if (!is.null(assets_dir)) {
      ggsave(file.path(assets_dir, paste0(cc_id, "_cross_contrast.png")), cc_res$plot, width = 9, height = 7, bg = "white")
    }
    
    if (interactive()) {
      print(cc_res$plot)
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("<img src='assets/03c_proteomics_clustering/%s_cross_contrast.png' width='100%%' />\n\n", cc_id))
    }
    
    # --- SUB-TAB: DATA TABLES ---
    cat("\n\n### Driver Tables\n\n")
    
    # Map the dynamic names back to the tables using the 'labels' list
    table_list <- list(
      "Shared Drivers" = cc_res$tables$shared,
      "temp_x" = cc_res$tables$x_specific,
      "temp_y" = cc_res$tables$y_specific
    )
    names(table_list)[2] <- cc_res$labels$x_sig_name
    names(table_list)[3] <- cc_res$labels$y_sig_name
    
    # Setup dynamic column names for pristine formatting
    col_logFC_x <- sprintf("logFC (%s)", conf$x_label)
    col_FDR_x <- sprintf("FDR (%s)", conf$x_label)
    col_logFC_y <- sprintf("logFC (%s)", conf$y_label)
    col_FDR_y <- sprintf("FDR (%s)", conf$y_label)
    
    for (t_name in names(table_list)) {
      df <- table_list[[t_name]]
      
      if (nrow(df) > 0) {
        # Format numbers and apply custom dynamic headers
        display_df <- df %>%
          mutate(
            logFC_X = round(logFC_X, 3),
            logFC_Y = round(logFC_Y, 3),
            FDR_X = formatC(FDR_X, format = "e", digits = 2),
            FDR_Y = formatC(FDR_Y, format = "e", digits = 2)
          ) %>%
          rename(
            !!col_logFC_x := logFC_X,
            !!col_FDR_x := FDR_X,
            !!col_logFC_y := logFC_Y,
            !!col_FDR_y := FDR_Y
          )
        
        if (isTRUE(getOption('knitr.in.progress'))) {
          html_table <- kableExtra::kbl(display_df, format = "html", align = "c", 
                                        caption = sprintf("Target Category: %s", t_name)) %>%
            kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE, position = "left") %>%
            kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
          
          cat(as.character(html_table))
          
        } else {
          cat(sprintf("\n**Target Category: %s**\n\n", t_name))
          print(rmarkdown::paged_table(display_df))
        }
        
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("> No features met the significance criteria for **%s**.\n", t_name))
      }
      cat("\n\n<br>\n\n") 
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("*No significant overlapping drivers found between these datasets.* \n\n")
  }
}
```
# Export
`r what_this_does("Exported the full vascular DEA results to hand off to the subsetted side-project script.", "Finalized the script execution.")`

#Export all DEA Results
for (name in names(global_dea_payloads)) {
  target_file <- file.path(output_dir_data, paste0(name, ".rds")) 
  saveRDS(global_dea_payloads[[name]], target_file)
}

# Export Vascular DEA (Legacy support)
if ("vascular_vs_nonvascular" %in% names(global_dea_payloads)) {
  saveRDS(
    global_dea_payloads[["vascular_vs_nonvascular"]], 
    file.path(output_dir_data, "full_vascular_dea_results.rds") 
  )
} else {
  cat("'vascular_vs_nonvascular' contrast was not found or failed. Export skipped.\n\n")
}

    file.path(output_dir_data, "dea_active_vs_control.rds") 
  )
}
